fusions.name: Reel Yourself In
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line at the target and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it. The barb deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Sweep
fusions.desc: A sweep of barbs that deals 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, with a 20% chance per hit to leave each [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Haul the Line
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Snagged Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
